newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-BOLTON AND WOLVERHAMPTON CHARGED OVER BRAWL.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BOLTON AND WOLVERHAMPTON CHARGED OVER BRAWL.

text.p: Top English first division sides Bolton and Wolverhampton have been charged by the Football Association (F.A.) over a mass brawl during their league clash last month.
"They've been charged under two rules, one relating to misconduct and one relating to the behaviour of the players," a spokeswoman said.
The brawl erupted after an altercation between Bolton's John Sheridan and Wolves' Geoff Thomas.
None of the players was booked or dismissed but referee David Allison later described the incident as "a mass confrontation involving between 18 and 20 players".
Bolton and Wolves, top and second respectively in the table, have until February 26 to reply to the charges.
